item.title: Self-Hosted Color Manipulation Libraries: Chroma.js vs TinyColor vs Color-Thief vs color-convert in 2026
item.description: Color manipulation in web applications goes far beyond just picking hex codes. Modern self-hosted applications need to generate accessible color palettes, extract dominant colors from user-uploaded images, convert between color spaces for consistent rendering, and guarantee WCAG contrast ratios — all in real-time on the server or browser.

item.title: Self-Hosted UX Prototyping & Wireframing: Quant-UX vs Wireflow vs Plasmic Compared 2026
item.description: UX prototyping and wireframing tools have traditionally been desktop applications or SaaS platforms — Sketch, Figma, Adobe XD. But a new generation of self-hosted alternatives puts collaborative design workflows on your own infrastructure, ideal for teams with security requirements, budget constraints, or a preference for open-source tooling.
